title: Vulkan Basics
concept: Vulkan bindings for XIOM — low-level GPU programming for graphics and compute, with full control over memory, synchronization, and pipeline state.
why: Vulkan is the industry standard for high-performance graphics. XIOM's safety guarantees combined with Vulkan's explicit control create a powerful GPU programming platform.
tips: Vulkan is verbose — consider a higher-level wrapper for rapid prototyping
Validate API usage with validation layers during development (VK_LAYER_KHRONOS_validation)
Double-buffering with fences prevents GPU/CPU synchronization stalls
Memory types matter — DEVICE_LOCAL is fast for GPU, HOST_VISIBLE for CPU upload
common_mistakes: Forgetting to destroy Vulkan objects — use RAII or explicit cleanup
Not synchronizing GPU operations — results in race conditions and flickering
Assuming the first GPU is the best — enumerate physical devices and pick by capability
